items.title: Hat day
items.body:
THIS IS FOR ONLY PRE-PRIMARY
🎩 Hey Everyone! Get Ready for HAT DAY!🎉

Don't forget, Thursday, 23rd July is HAT DAY! 🥳

Your Mission: Bring 1 cool, handmade hat to school!

Get creative with paper, fabric, or craft supplies—make it colorful, wild, and unique!

There will be a special shoutout in class for the most creative hats! Can't wait to see what you all come up with! ✨🎩
